title: Privacy Policy
content:
At SEOGBTools, we respect your privacy and are committed to handling your personal information responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, used, stored, and shared when you visit our website, create an account, purchase access to SEO tools, or contact our support team.

Please read this policy carefully to understand how your information may be processed when using our services.

1. Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with SEOGBTools, we may collect the following categories of information:

  • Account Information: Your name, email address, username, and account-related details.
  • Purchase Information: Order details, purchased subscriptions, transaction references, and billing information.
  • Payment Information: Information required to process payments. Payment card information may be handled directly by third-party payment processors, depending on the payment method used.
  • Technical Information: IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, and website access logs.
  • Support Communications: Messages, inquiries, and information you provide when contacting customer support.
  • Cookie Information: Information collected through cookies and similar technologies, where these are used on our website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We process personal information for purposes connected with operating and improving SEOGBTools, including:

  • Creating and managing customer accounts.
  • Processing purchases and maintaining transaction records.
  • Providing access to purchased SEO tools and subscriptions.
  • Responding to support requests and account inquiries.
  • Sending important service, payment, or account notifications.
  • Maintaining website functionality, security, and reliability.
  • Investigating suspected fraud, misuse, or unauthorized access.
  • Meeting applicable legal and regulatory obligations.
  • Understanding website performance and improving services, where analytics tools are used.

3. Legal Basis for Processing

Where applicable data protection laws require a legal basis, SEOGBTools processes personal information according to the circumstances and applicable law. Relevant legal bases may include performing a contract, complying with legal obligations, pursuing legitimate interests, or obtaining consent.

The legal basis for each processing activity should reflect the actual purpose and circumstances in which the information is used.

4. Cookies and Similar Technologies

SEOGBTools may use cookies and similar technologies to support essential website functions, maintain user sessions, remember preferences, and understand website usage.

Depending on the technologies enabled, cookies may include:

  • Essential Cookies: Used for functions such as account login, session management, and website security.
  • Preference Cookies: Used to remember selected website settings.
  • Analytics Cookies: Used to understand website traffic and usage patterns, where analytics services are enabled.
  • Marketing Cookies: Used for advertising or campaign measurement only where such technologies are implemented.

Where required by applicable law, we will request consent before placing non-essential cookies. You may also be able to manage cookies through your browser settings or the website's cookie preferences.

5. Payment Processing

When you purchase a product or subscription, payment-related information may be processed by the payment service provider used for your transaction.

The information shared with a payment provider depends on the payment method and may include transaction amounts, billing details, and payment references.

Any third-party payment provider is responsible for processing information according to its own applicable privacy terms and legal obligations.

6. Third-Party Services and SEO Tools

SEOGBTools provides access to SEO-related products and services. Depending on the service you use, certain technical information may be processed by hosting providers, payment services, analytics platforms, customer support systems, or third-party tools.

Third-party services may operate under their own privacy policies and terms. We encourage users to review those policies when accessing external services.

We do not claim that third-party SEO tool providers are affiliated with, endorse, or authorize SEOGBTools unless such a relationship is expressly stated and verified.

7. How We Share Information

We may share personal information when reasonably necessary to operate our services, including with:

  • Payment processors handling customer transactions.
  • Hosting and technical infrastructure providers.
  • Customer support and communication service providers.
  • Analytics or security service providers, where used.
  • Regulators or legal authorities when disclosure is required by applicable law.

We do not disclose personal information to unrelated parties without an appropriate purpose or legal basis.

8. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, loss, and disclosure.

However, no website, online transmission, or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Users should protect their account credentials and contact our support team if they suspect unauthorized access.

9. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain relevant business records, resolve disputes, and meet applicable legal obligations.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information, the purpose of processing, and applicable legal requirements.

When information is no longer required, it will be deleted, anonymized, or otherwise handled according to applicable retention requirements.

10. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location and applicable privacy laws, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including the right to:

  • Request access to personal information held about you.
  • Request correction of inaccurate information.
  • Request deletion of personal information in certain circumstances.
  • Request restriction of certain processing activities.
  • Object to certain uses of personal information.
  • Request a portable copy of eligible personal information.
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
  • Submit a complaint to the relevant data protection authority.

These rights are subject to applicable legal requirements and exceptions.

11. International Data Transfers

Some service providers may process information in countries outside your country of residence.

Where applicable law requires additional protections for international transfers, appropriate transfer mechanisms or safeguards must be used.

12. Children's Privacy

SEOGBTools services are intended for individuals who are legally permitted to purchase and use our services.

We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children who are not legally permitted to use our services. If you believe such information has been provided, please contact us.

13. External Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, SEO platforms, or other external services.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices of independent third-party websites. Please review their privacy policies before providing personal information.

14. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our services, information-handling practices, or applicable legal requirements.

When changes are made, we will update the "Last updated" date displayed at the top of this page.

15. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to make a privacy-related request, please contact SEOGBTools using the contact information provided on our Contact Us page.

Privacy Contact Email: Use the support contact listed on our Contact Us page.
